items.name: b12102
items.body:
<details open>

ggml: bound views by the bytes their strides reach (#31584)

* ggml: bound views by the bytes their strides reach

A view was checked against its source with the size of a contiguous
tensor of the same shape, computed before its strides were set. Views
whose rows overlap failed that check although they stay inside their
source, and views with wider strides passed it while reaching past
the end. The view functions now pass their strides to the tensor
constructor, which checks the bytes they actually reach, like
ggml_nbytes. The conv windows of delta_net are created with all their
rows at once instead of being widened after the check.

* ggml: assert that a strided view starts from contiguous elements

The view functions set nb[0] to the type size, so the source must have
contiguous elements along dim 0 for the view to read them.

</details>

<details open>

ggml : write host-buffer tensor data directly in gguf writer (#31144)

The gguf writer staged each tensor into a temporary vector before
writing it. For host-buffer tensors the data pointer is directly
writable, so skip the staging copy and write it straight to the file.
This avoids the per-tensor allocation, zero-init and memcpy.

items.body:
<details open>

common : fix -hf tag matching inside longer quant names (#31620)

* common : fix -hf tag matching inside longer quant names

":F16" picked a BF16 file when the repo had both, since "BF16"
contains "F16". The same applied to ":Q4_XS" vs "IQ4_XS". The tag
now has to start at a token boundary in the path.

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF (Mac Studio, M5 Ultra, 256GB)

* common : accept underscore as -hf tag boundary

Some repos separate the quant with an underscore, e.g.
stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash-GGUF-Q4_K_S ships
step3p5_flash_Q4_K_S-00001-of-00012.gguf, which :Q4_K_S no longer
matched. Add _ to the token boundary and pin the tag and default
lookup cases.

---------

Co-authored-by: Pascal <admin@serveurperso.com>

</details>
